text_style_prompt: A clean, well-made craftsman display trident in pieces: bright satin steel prongs with fine lengthwise brushing and polished bright bevelled rims, polished steel socket and collars, polished brass rings, a polished deep blue cabochon in a brass setting on the boss; the pole pieces are polished honey-orange yew wood with a straight grain under satin varnish with thin polished steel bands, the grip wrap dark brown leather in a neat spiral with fine steel wire, a polished steel butt cap.
